summary: Part 5 (20:26-20:49) closes the 3.0 Buybox video. Pierre explains 'lowest conditions' SKUs, where sellers compete on price only and not on score. He says these apply to the lowest storage, a neutral colour and the Good condition of iPhone models; which colour counts as neutral is not clear from the audio or the sheet. The reason he gives is marketing: Revibe wants to appear as the marketplace with the lowest price on these specific devices. All 7 frames show the Buybox tab of the 'Smart Cell x Revibe' Google Sheet. The web search he describes at 20:26 is never shown on screen.

terms.meaning: The algorithm that selects the best seller able to sell a SKU (narration 00:29-00:37). In the sheet it appears as 'Buybox AE' and 'Buybox SA' columns.

Pierre's term for SKUs where sellers compete only on price, not on score. Per narration, it applies to the lowest storage, a neutral colour (wording unclear) and the Good condition, for iPhone models.
Pierre says 'price neutral' at 19:43. At 04:54 he defines the neutral buy box as the price a seller should compete with at a score of 0%. No sheet column carries the name 'price neutral'.

Shown in a cell as '134 - Fulfillment' in Buybox AE for iPhone 7 32 GB Black Good. At 01:02-01:14 Pierre contrasts buy box with fulfillment: sellers can put price and prices only, not quantities, for direct shipping in all the countries. No fuller definition is given.
Estimated monthly sales a seller could do over the next 30 days, based on sales over the past 30 days across all countries. Shown as ranges such as 0-1, 20-50 and 50+.
Show TRUE when the seller is winning the SKU and FALSE when not. All FALSE in the visible rows.

terms.term: Min AE / Min SA and Price AE / Price SA
terms.meaning: Narration at 11:43 says the 'minimum' lets sellers define a minimum price so they do not have to refresh prices every hour (11:43-12:00). Price AE / Price SA are not defined in the video. All four columns are blank in the visible rows.

unclear.issue: Narration describes a customer searching the web for iPhone 12 Pro Max and 'the first one you will see from all marketplaces', but all 7 frames show the Google Sheet. No web search is on screen, so the marketplace result cannot be verified.

'the lowest storage neutral color' with '{colored?}': the colour values sit in the 'Storage (laptop) Color (phone)' column, 'Colour (laptop)' is blank, and no column is labelled neutral. Which colour counts as neutral is unclear.
Pierre says 'not the gold but i think this works with the graphite yes' before the 128 graphite example. Colour choice is uncertain and not shown on screen.
'price neutral' and 'price buy box' are not matched to screen columns. The sheet shows Buybox AE/SA and Price AE/SA, and Price AE is blank on row 5, so the mapping is uncertain.
The 1059 figure for iPhone 12 Pro Max is not visible in any of the 7 frames, so it cannot be checked on screen.
'all vendors will be what we call the lowest conditions' is hard to parse. It may mean sellers on the iPhone 12 Pro Max listing are in lowest-conditions mode, but this is not confirmed on screen.
